# EWS logon returns an endpoint URI before the asynchronous connectivity result

Fresh full five-file298-line C++/IDL/Rust/JS patch read. VerifyLogon stops manufacturing synchronous success and calls an EWS root-folder connectivity operation. Rust requests a distinguished root folder with IdOnly shape, requires a single response and validates it, then reports the result through the listener. Creating/returning the endpoint nsIURI is distinct from asynchronous authentication success. ConfigVerifier treats the returned endpoint as a generic URI and only reads nsIMsgMailNewsUrl fields after instanceof checks. Complete Bug and all three actual review rows/full timeline read. The reviewer rejects returning success without an IDL return value; the landed Rust bridge now constructs and returns the endpoint URI. The extra-QI removal is applied in this exact XPCOM JS path after instanceof exposes the methods; it is not a blanket JavaScript instanceof rule. The bug-autolink naming preference remains Not Done and the complete URL comment remains.

Scope: EWS connectivity result/return and ConfigVerifier contract.
